stages.headline: If the three sides of one triangle are proportional to the three sides of another, the triangles are similar.
stages.headlineEnglish: If the three sides of one triangle are proportional to the three sides of another, the triangles are similar.

stages.headline: To check, sort the sides of each triangle and compare the ratios.
stages.headlineEnglish: To check, sort the sides of each triangle and compare the ratios.

stages.headline: If even one ratio differs, they are not similar: 3, 4, 5 and 6, 8, 9 are not, since 5 · 2 = 10 ≠ 9.
stages.headlineEnglish: If even one ratio differs, they are not similar: 3, 4, 5 and 6, 8, 9 are not, since 5 · 2 = 10 ≠ 9.

stages.headline: Which triangle is similar to the one with sides 2, 3, 4?

stages.headline: A triangle has sides 4, 5, 6; a similar one has perimeter 30. Find its largest side.
